summary: The manufacturer wording remains unresolved in the newer official Revision E. This separate handling decision limits preliminary supply/ambient screening to the mutually supported high-voltage subset without rewriting the historical observations.

limitations: This is an Agent-derived handling boundary, not a manufacturer clarification, canonical Fact, complete recommended operating envelope or circuit-safety recommendation.

Use actual operating supply extremes, including tolerances and ripple, and ambient temperature extremes; nominal labels alone are insufficient. Power sequencing and transients require separate checks.
I2C timing and speed, loading, logic levels, current, reset behavior and thermal design remain independently constrained; this supply/ambient screen does not approve them.

Every point outside this deliberately narrow subset is NOT_ESTABLISHED by this policy, not asserted unsafe or nonfunctional. This includes lower-voltage operation even where some original wording supports it.
Only MCP23017-E/SO, the I2C standard part in SO 28-lead wide SOIC, is in scope. Do not transfer this receipt to MCP23S17, another package, or automotive qualification.
The cover includes two overlapping lower-temperature voltage bullets without an explicit mapping. This receipt does not guess their intended association or expand the policy from them.
Absolute-maximum stress ratings are not operating authorization. The E temperature ordering suffix is not a guarantee for all voltage-temperature combinations.
